prompt: The family emoji is the sequence man, ZERO WIDTH JOINER (U+200D), woman, ZWJ, girl. Which statements are true?

options.text: It consists of five Unicode code points: three emoji and two ZWJ characters.
UAX #29 treats the whole emoji ZWJ sequence as a single extended grapheme cluster.
Every tokenizer encodes it as exactly one token.
How many tokens it takes depends on the tokenizer, and there is no guarantee of one token per grapheme cluster.
Its grapheme cluster count equals its code point count.

explanation: Rule GB11 of UAX #29 forbids breaking within emoji ZWJ sequences, so five code points form one grapheme cluster. Tokens are a separate unit defined by the tokenizer: they can be words, subwords, characters or bytes, and counts vary by model.
